findings: The supported Poky 6.0.2 linux-yocto do_compile workload held the eight-logical-CPU host at a 99.6646% trimmed-mean utilization for the complete 120-second sample window.
Daemon plus one interactive client consumed a 0.9662% trimmed mean of one logical CPU; input p95 was 5.3843 ms and every IPC continuity/cancellation check passed.
High-rate job progress now updates the bounded journal incrementally, compatibility decoding is generation-cached, and active daemon polling uses readiness plus a 50 ms supervisor bound.
At 90% or greater host utilization during live work, presentation coalesces to 1 Hz while input and resize stay immediate; below saturation ordinary activity remains 4 Hz.
